These comprise restructuring costs impairment of property plant and equipment and
intangible assets (other than goodwill and non-commercialized intangible assets)
litigations and onerous contracts results on disposals of property plant and equipment
and specific other income and expenses that fall within the control of operating segments.

Restructuring costs are restricted to dismissal indemnities and employee benefits paid
to terminated employees upon the reorganization of a business or function.

These comprise impairment of goodwill and non-commercialized intangible assets results
on disposals of businesses (including impairment and subsequent remeasurement of
businesses classified as held-for-sale as well as other directly related disposal costs like
restructuring costs directly linked to businesses disposed of and legal advisory and other
professional fees) acquisition-related costs the effect of hyperinflation accounting and
income and expenses that fall beyond the control of operating segments or relate to
events such as wars and natural disasters including extreme weather events linked to
climate change as well as expropriation of assets.
